ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.04:0.96 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity dark pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity dark pigmentation across >95% of the surface area; discrete high-intensity white clusters at the extreme distal tips and sparse white pixel speckling on the medial-left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Symmetric V-shaped central depression with an interior angle of approximately 88 degrees and a depth ratio of 0.12 relative to visible lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (1-3 pixel peaks) along the entire trailing edge, with increased jaggedness on the outer mid-section of the right lobe lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge trailing to acute, slightly posterior-oriented distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Circular high-contrast white pixel clusters localized on the outer margins of both the left and right distal tips, consistent with barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple unaligned white linear pixel streaks (rake marks) scattered across the central-left lobe and lower-inner right lobe surfaces.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinctive high-contrast white 'S-shaped' or 'figure-eight' mark on the inner right lobe near the trailing edge; minor irregular trailing edge indentation on the outer left lobe.
